Validation of “No replacement identified”
Leeuwarden · 2011–2025
977 demolition cases tested against current BAG footprints.
This map does not redefine the replacement indicator. It asks whether a current BAG pand spatially overlaps the former demolition footprint, even when that pand failed the thesis replacement rule. The best candidate is the current pand with the largest intersection area.
Current BAG overlap with demolished footprint
No current BAG overlap (412)
Current overlap <10% (61)
Current overlap 10–50% (164)
Current overlap 50–80% (68)
Current overlap ≥80% (272)
Red outline/fill = historical demolished footprint
Old coverage = intersection ÷ demolished area.
Current coverage = intersection ÷ current area.
IoU = intersection ÷ union.
